data.long_meaning: The name Hakeemah is derived from the Arabic word 'hakeem' which means 'wise' or 'intelligent'. In Islamic tradition, Hakeemah is believed to symbolize wisdom and knowledge, as well as the ability to make just decisions. The name holds deep spiritual significance in the teachings of the Quran and Hadith. The name Hakeemah carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hakeemah usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

By giving their daughters this name, parents hope to instill in them the values of wisdom, intelligence, and sound judgment.

The Quran emphasizes the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom, which are essential for leading a virtuous life and pleasing Allah. In Surah Ar-Ra'd, Allah SWT says, "And it is He Who has made you successors upon the earth and raised some of you above others in degrees [of rank] that He may test you in what He has given you. The end goal is not worldly gain but only His Pleasure." (Quran 13:7) The name Hakeemah reflects this spiritual aspiration, as it reminds us of the importance of attaining knowledge and wisdom, and using it to make just decisions that please Allah.
